usedFor: CalendarHero holds meeting requests and contacts, and Memory keeps their details as key-value pairs through “Memory”.

bestTemplate.name: “Meeting Request Becomes Event” in CalendarHero, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: A confirmed meeting is worth keeping, so the action stores its details under a key you can look up later.

watchOut: “Memory” in Memory stores key-value pairs, so choose key names that stay unique per meeting request.
